info.title: site-assistant
info.description: Stages 1–3. Same-origin cookie API; writes require exact Origin, JSON Content-Type (multipart only for knowledge/upload) and X-CSRF-Protection: 1. No CORS. Login/register: 10 attempts per peer IP per 15 minutes, 4 concurrent password operations per process. Error messages are localized by clients from error.code.

post.summary: POST SSE: start, delta, complete, error. Same cookie/Origin/CSRF as JSON requests. No URL tokens.

200.description: SSE start data=AIResult (processing), delta data={text}, complete data=AIResult (including replay), error data={code}. Partial text is never persisted as completed. HTTP errors before the stream remain JSON.
